about: Candidates read in file order (not time order). N_on counts 1850 < M < 1880, N_off counts 1820 < M < 1840 or 1890 < M < 1910 (MeV/c^2); the background expected in the window is b = (30/40) N_off, z = (N_on - b)/sqrt(b). k is 1-based.

line5sigma.about: T2's close: the counted background in the window 1850-1880 is b = 0.75 x N_off (all 91 583 candidates); a window holding b + 5 sqrt(b) would be exactly 5 sigma, (N_on - b)/sqrt(b) = 5. Spread evenly over its 15 bins of 2 MeV that is `level` a bin. set is a dk-curve parameter set: f 'flat', a = level per bin of 2 MeV, drawn over range.
